description: This Java source file defines the SchedulerStopListener class, which implements the JobListener interface from Quartz. Its purpose is to listen for job execution events and stop the scheduler once a job completes, identified by a scheduler name fetched from the job's data map.

classes.name: SchedulerStopListener
classes.description: A Quartz JobListener implementation that stops a specified scheduler when a job finishes execution.

methods.name: SchedulerStopListener
methods.description: Constructor that injects a JobRegisterService dependency.

methods.name: jobToBeExecuted
methods.description: Callback for when a job is about to execute; currently empty.

methods.name: jobExecutionVetoed
methods.description: Callback if job execution is vetoed; currently empty.

methods.name: jobWasExecuted
methods.description: Callback after a job has executed; starts a thread to stop the scheduler if a name is present in the job data map.
